scope.method: full-axe-document-analysis plus authenticated page contract checks

incompleteCountInterpretation: 233 incomplete rule-result occurrences and5671 associated node occurrences are summed across these122 analyses. They are not counts of unique defects or unique DOM nodes, and are not passed conformance checks.

cleanup.scope: Only the audit-owned test accounts, sessions and known Chrome main processes. No unrelated host process or user account is covered by this cleanup assertion.

paletteKeyboardProbe.scope: The actual PageDown key advanced the focused scroll region from0to13px, then its saved scroll position was restored. This is not a natural Tab-order, full-page-scroll, latency or comprehensive keyboard-conformance test.

checkApplicability.customerStaffMfaChecks: preStaffMfaVerified and staffMfaVerified are conditional not-applicable true values for customer, not proof of customer MFA enrollment.
checkApplicability.customerWorkspaceLoaded: Not applicable to customer; customer uses the account shell rather than the staff workspace endpoint.
checkApplicability.ownedRequestChecks: Positive ownership/detail checks apply to the single owned-request-detail case. Other cases retain conditional true values, not additional request-ownership coverage.
checkApplicability.paletteKeyboardScrollVerified: Only the superAdmin/fa/admin/pages case performs this extra keyboard witness.
checkApplicability.privateNoindex: Expected privacy behavior is verified; no SEO score is measured or improved by exposing private routes.

evidenceLimits: All cases use one recorded attempt; failures from the previous cohort remain separately preserved.
This sample contains112 Persian views and10 English views. It is not the full530-view private Lighthouse inventory.
Axe incomplete results require manual review. Zero automatic violations does not establish full WCAG conformance.
No Lighthouse performance, field INP, real-device Core Web Vitals or score-budget pass is claimed.

Only explicit counts, boolean contract checks, logical roles/locales/routes and public source/build identity are exported. Raw Axe node HTML, DOM text, screenshots, actor identifiers, credentials, private origins, environment or input fingerprints are not included.
The raw private source evidence remains unchanged; this derived JSON is not a byte-identical copy of the raw reports.
